version_metadata.description:
NeuroCall is the premier operative neurosurgery reference atlas, crisis head CT workstation, and frontline emergency triage manual engineered for neurosurgeons, spine surgeons, neurocritical care teams, and surgical residents on call.

Featuring 106 studio-grade photorealistic master plates, clarifying pathology schematics, and interactive diagnostic calipers, NeuroCall bridges high-magnification microsurgical anatomy with rapid bedside clinical decision-making.

KEY CLINICAL FEATURES:

• COMPLETE SURGICAL ATLAS (106 MASTER PLATES):
Organized into 4 specialized operative domains: Master Corridors (Plate 1), Cranial & Skull Base (45 Plates), Spine & CVJ (55 Plates), and Pediatric Neurosurgery (5 Plates). Each plate features high-magnification multi-touch zoom (up to 5.0x), dual-finger canvas translation, anatomical callouts, sequential dissection steps, and complication hazard alerts:
1. Anterior & Skull Base: Pterional, trans-sylvian, PComA clipping, FT-OZO, supraorbital keyhole, and endoscopic endonasal sellar anatomy.
2. Cranial Convexity & Trauma: Bifrontal, temporal, parietal lobar mapping, decompressive hemicraniectomy, and temporal lobectomy.
3. Posterior Fossa: Retromastoid keyhole, retrosigmoid asterion craniectomy, CPA microdissection (CN VII/VIII/V), suboccipital craniectomy, and far-lateral transcondylar approach.
4. Vascular & Ventricular: Neonatal fontanelle EVD, MIPS tubular ICH evacuation, aneurysmal SAH cisternal anatomy, and hypertensive ganglionic ICH.
5. Craniovertebral Junction: CCJ anatomy, Chiari I decompression, Harms C1-C2 screw fixation, and odontoid biomechanics.
6. Cervical Spine: ACDF, posterior laminectomy with lateral mass screws, jumped facet reduction, and spondylotic myelopathy.
7. Thoracic & Oncology: Costotransversectomy, burst fracture stabilization, en bloc spondylectomy, and metastatic cord compression (MESCC/Bilsky).
8. Lumbar Degenerative & Fusion: Microdiscectomy, lateral recess stenosis, cauda equina syndrome, TLIF, transpsoas LLIF, and 360-degree circumferential fusion.
9. Deformity & Dural Salvage: Smith-Petersen/Ponte osteotomies, pedicle subtraction osteotomy (PSO), and pseudomeningocele repair.
10. Peripheral, Functional & Pediatric: Carpal tunnel, cubital tunnel transposition, brachial plexus Oberlin transfers, STN DBS, and myelomeningocele repair.

• 2 AM CRISIS HEAD CT WORKSTATION:
Standardized calipers and emergency thresholds for acute EDH, SDH, uncal herniation, and posterior fossa hemorrhage.

• FRONTLINE ER CONSULTS & 5-PHASE TRIAGE:
Actionable order sets, operative indications, and clinical decision algorithms for acute intracranial hemorrhage, shunt tap dynamics, facet dislocations, cauda equina syndrome, and spinal cord injury.

• BEDSIDE HARDWARE & PROCEDURES:
Step-by-step guides for Kocher's point EVD, Camino parenchymal ICP bolt, lumbar puncture with manometry, continuous lumbar drains, and arterial lines.

• CLINICAL CALCULATORS & DOSING HUB:
Deterministic scoring for CPP, Hemphill ICH Score with ABC/2 volume, Hunt & Hess, WFNS, Modified Fisher, Spetzler-Martin, TLICS, SLICS, SINS, and osmotherapy bolusing.

• ATTENDING SBAR TELEPROMPTER:
High-stress on-call case formulation with 1-tap clipboard copying formatted for spoken call, Epic Haiku, and iMessage.

CLINICAL REFERENCE DISCLAIMER:
NeuroCall is designed strictly as an educational and bedside reference tool for neurosurgeons, spine surgeons, neurocritical care teams, and surgical residents on call. Calculations and risk scores are clinical decision-support aids that do not replace independent clinical judgment.

Engineered for instantaneous bedside execution with zero ads, zero user tracking, and full offline accessibility.

app_review_information.review_notes:
Dear Apple App Review Team,

NeuroCall is an institutional operative neurosurgery reference atlas, crisis head CT workstation, and frontline emergency consultation manual engineered from scratch by Dr. A. Alex Mohit, MD, PhD (practicing neurosurgeon and spine surgeon, developer of PJKPredict, ID 6738947265, currently live in the Medical category).

KEY REVIEW DETAILS:
1. TARGET AUDIENCE: Designed exclusively as an operative reference and educational training workstation for neurosurgeons, spine surgeons, neurocritical care teams, and surgical residents/fellows on call.
2. 100% ORIGINAL & DE NOVO ARTWORK: All 106 photorealistic surgical plates and clarifying anatomical schematics are 100% original, de novo digital medical illustrations authored and composite-engineered specifically for NeuroCall under the direct surgical guidance of Dr. Mohit. Zero third-party copyrighted figures, textbook scans, or external atlas plates are utilized.
3. FULL 106-PLATE OPERATIVE ATLAS: NeuroCall spans 4 dedicated clinical domains: Master 360° Corridors (Plate 1), Cranial & Skull Base (45 Plates), Spine & CVJ (55 Plates), and Pediatric Neurosurgery & Dysraphism (5 Plates), alongside clarifying cross-sectional pathology schematics.
4. ZERO SIGN-IN / INSTANT ACCESSIBILITY: The application requires zero login, zero external credentials, zero subscriptions, and zero internet connection to evaluate. All 106 plates, crisis head CT checklists, bedside procedure guides, and calculators function 100% offline immediately upon first launch.
5. HIPAA & PRIVACY COMPLIANCE: NeuroCall collects zero personal or patient health information (PHI). No user data is ever collected or transmitted off the device.
6. CLINICAL GROUNDING: All emergency protocols, hematoma evacuation guidelines, and clinical calculators (CPP, GCS, Hunt & Hess, Spetzler-Martin, ICH Score, TLICS, SLICS, SINS) are derived strictly from established, peer-reviewed medical literature (Brain Trauma Foundation, AHA/ASA, and AANS/CNS guidelines).

Thank you for your review,
Alex Mohit, MD, PhD
Department of Neurological Surgery
